world_org_meetings.title: U.S. and Cuban officials get into shouting match on floor of United Nations
world_org_meetings.description: U.S. and Cuban officials engaged in a stunning shouting match on the floor of the United Nations General Assembly on Tuesday, the latest in a series of public spats between the longtime adversaries over Washington's escalating economic campaign against Havana.

world_org_meetings.title: Canada needs concrete results from EU summit this week, former envoy says
world_org_meetings.description: Ahead of this week's Canada-European Union summit, Prime Minister Mark Carney said both parties are hammering out a "new, ambitious alliance" after pledging deeper ties with Europe last month.

world_org_meetings.title: EU member states wrangle over all-important budget: Is a deal this year feasible?
world_org_meetings.description: A marathon EU summit on October 15-16 failed to produce a breakthrough on the European Union's next long-term budget. Although EU leaders put on a brave face at the end of the talks by saying that "the way forward is clearer", EU capitals appear deadlocked on what that path is. At stake is the EU's ability to finance its strategic priorities from 2028 to 2034. The main dividing line is between the so-called "frugal countries", who want deep cuts to the proposed budget, and the "friends of cohesion", who say that cuts are not the answer.

world_org_meetings.title: World set to breach 1.5°C warming limit set by Paris Climate Agreement
world_org_meetings.description: The UN is warning that global commitments to cut planet-heating emissions are falling far short of the Paris climate goals of 1.5 degrees Celsius warming – and put the world on course for 2.6C warming this century. The report by the United Nations Environment Programme lays bare the chasm between rhetoric and action when it comes to tackling global warming, and the challenge before political leaders at November's COP31 climate summit - set to take place next month in Turkey. Story by Emerald Maxwell.

world_org_meetings.title: Search under way for four soldiers missing after gang attack in Haiti
world_org_meetings.description: The UN Security Council holds a meeting on Haiti; the attack on UN-backed forces is expected to dominate the discussions.

diplomatic_visits.title: Canada, U.A.E. sign defence, energy agreements during crown prince's visit
diplomatic_visits.description: Canada and the United Arab Emirates signed a handful of trade and infrastructure agreements during the crown prince of Abu Dhabi's visit to Ottawa.

diplomatic_visits.title: King Charles confronts calls for slavery apology during Caribbean tour
diplomatic_visits.description: King Charles III began a Caribbean tour in the Bahamas on Tuesday, acknowledging “the great suffering of the past” amid calls for an apology over slavery. The 77-year-old monarch, who is undergoing cancer treatment, will also visit Guyana and Antigua and Barbuda, highlighting climate threats and attending a Commonwealth summit with Queen Camilla.

diplomatic_visits.title: Iran war live: Pezeshkian says Middle East can solve own issues without US
diplomatic_visits.description: Iranian president's words came at summit for gas exporting countries in Russia.

diplomatic_visits.title: Caribbean seeks reparations and questions role of monarchy before King Charles visits
diplomatic_visits.description: The royals are coming, and the Caribbean wants to be heard

diplomatic_visits.title: Why the King's Caribbean tour could be 'biggest risk of his reign'
diplomatic_visits.description: The meticulously-planned visit takes in three countries in nine days - but is not without jeopardy.

elections.title: Watch: What happens now after close vote in Israeli election?
elections.description: Polls have closed in the Israeli election, but there is no clear winner.

elections.title: What does Israel's election mean for Gaza and the wider world?
elections.description: The BBC's diplomatic correspondent James Landale reports from Jerusalem as ballots are cast.

elections.title: Israel's voter turnout soars as Netanyahu faces a tight election
elections.description: Israelis voted in their highest numbers in over two decades in a tense national election to decide whether to stick with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's far-right coalition.

elections.title: Bolsonaro's party accepts Brazil election defeat, but he refuses to concede
elections.description: Brazil's opposition party accepts President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's election victory, but Flávio Bolsonaro won't concede, while President Trump calls the vote "rigged" without offering evidence.

elections.title: Netanyahu, Eisenkot stake rival claims to lead Israel after deadlocked vote
elections.description: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and rival Gadi Eisenkot offered competing claims to lead Israel after Tuesday's election, with Netanyahu calling for a right-wing government and Eisenkot saying voters had rejected the longtime Israeli leader, even as early counting showed no clear winner.
